buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Eligibility Criteria: 1) Bulk order will be placed on the manufacturer or its authorized dealer having proven performance. The bidder or its OEM should have supplied same or similar item (similar item means computer of any type) for minimum 20% of tendered quantity against orders placed, in any one of the last THREE FINANCIAL YEARS or current financial year up to date of tender opening to any Central/State Govt. Organization/PSU 2) The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be a minimum of 100 Crore or above. D ocumentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate fro m the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 years old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of the constitution shall be considered for these criteria. 3) Firm should submit the undertaking for the following otherwise offer will be rejected :- a) Firm not have been blacklisted by any Government Dept/PSU/Banks currently. b) Any vendor under the GeM watchlist/Notified list in the past 2 years c)There should not be any open incident on the GeM portal against the Bidder and OEM. d)The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership, or similar proceedings, and should not be bankrupt. 4) Dedicated working contact numbers/toll-free numbers of Bidder & Escalation matrix of OEM/Bidder with working contact numbers have to be uploaded. If the numbers are found dummy/bogus/invalid/fake during

our verification, the bid is liable for rejection. 5) ISO-9001, 14001 and 27001 certificates of the OEM are to be uploaded at the time of bidding. 6) Warranty period: 3 years. ATC Specification -Desktops Computer. OEM logo embossed/ etched (No Stickers) for all accessories like Keyboard, Mouse, and Monitor. License Key is to be made available in BIOS. The Bidder/OEM should supply the Windows License Key in BI OS. Bidder should clearly take ownership for genuineness of the Operating System (OS) that will be suppli ed (DIGITAL INJECTION OF LICENSE KEY SHOULD BE DONE IN BIOS) in all machines as per the bid. The follo wing documents can be considered to verify the proof of genuineness of the factory pre-loaded Operating system with Microsoft DPK License key loaded into the BIOS: (OEM of the Desktop Computer systems may be a device partner of Microsoft and holds a Microsoft Authorization form, relevant proof for factory pre-loa ded genuine OS as well as capability to inject license key into BIOS to be provided.) Datasheets to be submitted along with the offer. Onsite support should be provided during the warranty period. Certification: The Desktop model should be CERTIFIED FOR MICROSOFT WINDOWS (Relevant Certificate to be submitted). Proposed Model no. should be mentioned on the certification report. NOTE: Hardware core s pecifications should be the same which are certified for the respective models. A relevant certificate for th e original factory-loaded OS should be uploaded. OEM website to have a facility for checking product technical specifications and warranty details using the unique product serial number of the delivered machine.
